facts.label: Past progressive com when
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para o que estava acontecendo e when + passado simples para o fato curto: I was swimming when you called.

facts.label: Ação em andamento
facts.sub: Para falar do que estava acontecendo, use was/were + verbo com -ing: I was swimming. They were jumping. Use was com I, he, she, it e were com you, we, they.

facts.label: Ação curta
facts.sub: Use when para a ação curta que interrompe: I was swimming when you called. A parte com when usa o passado simples: called, arrived, started.

pages.title: Ação em andamento
pages.model: I was swimming when you called.

solo: Aluno diz a frase com 3 combinações.
group: Padrão: “I was {verb} when {event}.”. Nota: I was + -ing + when + fato.
Cada aluno troca um espaço: swimming, reading, sitting.
extra90: Peça a versão negativa ou em pergunta.

pages.title: Mais de uma pessoa
pages.model: The kids were jumping when I arrived.

solo: Aluno diz a frase com 3 combinações.
group: Padrão: “The kids were {verb} when {event}.”. Nota: Were + -ing + when + fato.
Cada aluno troca um espaço: jumping, shouting, playing.
extra90: Peça a versão negativa ou em pergunta.

pages.title: Laboratório de sons · o som
pages.what: Was soa “uóz” e were soa “uêr”. Na fala rápida, was fica fraco: “uez”.
pages.tip: Compare was e were: a vogal muda.

solo: Modele, peça repetição, depois uso livre.
group: Foco: was e were. Diga were como “uêr”.
Coro, depois um a um; ouça sem corrigir tudo.
extra90: Cada aluno grava um áudio de 10 segundos e compara com o modelo.

pages.title: Encontre a frase natural

opts: I was swimming when you called.
I was swim when you called.

items.why: In questions, were goes before you.

opts: I was reading when she was calling.
I was reading when she called.
items.why: Use the simple past after when for the short event.

pages.instruction: Escolha a forma que resolve a situação; explique o erro comum.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Escolha a frase mais natural. → I was swimming when you called.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → They were jumping.
Escolha a frase mais natural. → What were you doing?
Escolha a frase mais natural. → I was reading when she called.
